decisions.what: Replaced existing #gallery section with new CSS Grid gallery featuring 8 Unsplash fashion images
decisions.why: The existing gallery section (id='gallery') used dark brand theme placeholders without real images. The spec required a new gallery with bg-gray-50, CSS Grid with col-span/row-span variations, skeleton loaders with data-skeleton attribute, and actual Unsplash image URLs.

decisions.what: Applied col-span-2 row-span-2 to items 1 and 5, col-span-2 to item 3
decisions.why: Spec explicitly calls out these span overrides for visual interest in the grid layout.

decisions.what: Used loading='eager' for items 1-2, loading='lazy' for items 3-8
decisions.why: Spec requires eager loading for first two items and lazy loading for the rest to improve perceived performance on mobile connections.

decisions.what: Appended gallery skeleton handler to app.js after existing mobile menu code with clear section comment
decisions.why: Spec says to append functionality and use clear comments to separate gallery logic from navigation logic.

decisions.what: Added IntersectionObserver in app.js as optional enhancement for viewport-aware lazy loading
decisions.why: Spec explicitly mentions IntersectionObserver as an optional enhancement for lazy loading optimization.
